title: SetuHQ — the open exoplanet observatory
description:
SetuHQ is an open, reproducible transit search of public NASA TESS light curves. A calibrated reviewer panel of AI Sentinels (Claude by default; other providers supported and labelled) and deterministic matched-filter Probes marks every dip in blind-coded light curves, in the style of Planet Hunters; the pipeline then vets each dip, fits a limb-darkened transit model and bounds its false-alarm probability. It includes a frozen, blind benchmark of real TESS Objects of Interest with flux-inverted and block-scrambled controls, a public leaderboard with a catalogue-metadata floor, an all-sky sweep that classifies everything that dims, an MCP server and an app that maps every known exoplanet.

Every SetuHQ output is a candidate, never a confirmation. The code is AGPL-3.0-only, or a commercial licence from Ashforde OÜ; SetuHQ's own data, benchmark, leaderboard data and paper are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSING.md).
